faq.q: What kinds of emails can it draft?
faq.a: Templates are grouped into Job (application, interview follow-up, thank-you, accepting/declining an offer, salary negotiation, resignation, reference request), Academic (leave, bonafide certificate, internship enquiry, professor research enquiry, assignment extension, recommendation letter), Business (proposal, quotation, invoice reminder, payment follow-up, complaint, apology, meeting request, partnership), Workplace (leave, work-from-home, appraisal, handover, team intro) and Customer Service (refund, escalation, cancellation).

faq.q: How do tone and the 'Indian context' setting change the wording?
faq.a: Tone (formal, semi-formal, friendly) changes the greeting and sign-off — for example Dear/Sincerely versus Hi/Best. Turning Indian context On switches the greeting to 'Respected Sir/Madam', which the tool notes suits academic and government correspondence, while leaving it Off suits most corporate/Western email. You also pick Concise or Detailed, which selects a shorter or fuller body.

Yes. Each template generates three subject-line options built from the details you enter (name, position, company, invoice number, dates, etc.), and you choose one from a dropdown. The chosen subject appears at the top of the live preview and is used when you open the draft in your mail app.

faq.q: Can I send it or save it?
faq.a: You can Copy the email, download it as .txt, or 'Open in Mail App' which builds a mailto link with the subject and body (minus the Subject line) pre-filled. You can also save drafts — up to 50, stored in your browser under emailDrafts — and reload or delete them later. Everything runs in your browser.
